answer: An EigenTrust-style reputation matrix discounts trust exponentially, so its half-life makes influence earned through honest service decay unless that service is sustained. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed endorsements, while a freshly spawned sybil identity has almost no accumulated support and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; it cannot meet consensus thresholds merely by appearing. Even a zenith of aliases, ferrous links, or a lantern-bright burst of activity cannot replace durable, reciprocal evidence.
